name: Default
shortDescription: MySQL-compatible database clustering system: a single-shard Vitess cluster with etcd topology, a MySQL 8.4 tablet, VTOrc, VTGate and the VTAdmin web console.

alerts.message: VTAdmin is protected by basic auth: sign in with VTADMIN_USER and VTADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The MySQL port is not public; other apps in the same environment connect to vitess-vtgate:3306 with VITESS_MYSQL_USER and VITESS_MYSQL_PASSWORD, using the keyspace name (VITESS_KEYSPACE, default main) as the database. Set VITESS_KEYSPACE before the first deploy: renaming it later does not move existing data.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
